canonical_project: Firmus Project Southgate AI Factory (St Leonards)
notes: AI Factory campus at St Leonards (5 ha; two server halls, office and associated infrastructure), endorsed/approved by Launceston City Council (Sep 2025); Stage 1a 44MW by 2026 (AU$2.1bn investment), Stage 1b doubles to 90MW; further ~300MW Stage 2 planned subject to final approvals; renewable-powered; reported scalable to ~400MW. capacity_mw = Stage 1 combined 90MW (grade B, DCD + The Mercury).
